rules.implementation: Store the received text in raw_text; never overwrite it with normalized output.
Apply Unicode NFC to normalized_text for canonically equivalent characters.
Replace non-printing control characters (except ordinary whitespace) with spaces.
Collapse consecutive spaces, tabs, and newlines to one space and trim leading/trailing whitespace.
Do not translate, infer missing words, change letter case, or remove punctuation in the normalized text.
Require timezone-aware ISO 8601 timestamps and store as UTC with a trailing Z.
Accept only numeric values from 0 through 1; use null if unavailable; do not interpret ASR confidence as candidate quality.
Use a Day 22 question_id where applicable; allow null for unprompted/free-form turns.
Use positive unique sequence_no values and unique turn_id values within each transcript.
Store language as a BCP 47 tag at transcript and turn level; do not assume that translations exist.
